provenance.verifierNote: As a clothing retailer placing textiles on the Irish market, Primark falls within the producer definition set to be obligated under the Irish textile EPR scheme.

angle: Primark places large volumes of textiles on the Irish market, so from 2028 it becomes a fee-paying producer under the textile EPR scheme. A relationship built now, whilst Ireland designs its scheme, positions Swap'n'Serve as an established reuse counterparty rather than a 2028 cold approach.
